verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents automations that integrate with GitHub and run on schedules or webhook events (gh-4). Its marketed automation flows explicitly end by opening a pull request: the CI-failure fixer opens a PR with a proposed fix (docs-9), and the security-alert remediator opens a PR with the remediation (docs-10). This shows that automatically opening a PR when an agent task completes is a delivered capability, backed by Git integrations (docs-26). Missing for 10: detailed configuration docs for attaching a PR-on-completion step to arbitrary tasks, options controlling PR content such as branch, title or draft status, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
